items.summary_zh: 美国和以色列炸弹开始倒向伊朗100多天后,双方都声称取得了胜利,这说明每一方都需要一条出路。

items.title: Should the US impose a teen social media ban like the UK?
items.title_zh: 美国是否应该像英国那样实行青少年社交媒体禁令?
items.summary: The UK is imposing a social media ban for children under the age of 16. British politicians say they will provide an update on further restrictions like potential curfews and curbing of "addictive" features like infinite scroll and AI chatbots, in July.
items.summary_zh: 联合王国正在对16岁以下儿童实施社交媒体禁令。 英国政治人物表示,他们会在7月提供进一步限制的最新情况,如潜在的宵禁,并遏制"附加"特征,如无限卷轴和AI聊天人等.

items.title: Weapons, money and ships: How is this Iran deal different from others?
items.title_zh: 武器、金钱和船只: 伊朗与他国有何不同?
items.summary: President Donald Trump has formally signed a deal with Iran to end the conflict that began on 28 February when the US and Israel launched air strikes against Tehran and across the country.
items.summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统已正式与伊朗签署协议以结束从2月28日美以双方对德黑兰和全国各地发动空袭起的冲突.

items.title: Will Putin change tactics after Ukrainian drone attacks?
items.title_zh: 乌克兰无人机攻击后普京是否会改变战术?
items.summary: Moscow has come under the largest Ukrainian attack since the start of the full-scale war, with close to 200 drones hitting targets around the Russian capital and setting columns of thick smoke billowing high into the sky.
items.summary_zh: 莫斯科受到乌克兰自全面战争开始以来最大的攻击,近200架无人机击中了俄罗斯首都周围的目标,并设置了高空飘来飘去的浓烟柱.

items.title: Moment Trump signs US-Iran agreement at Palace of Versailles
items.title_zh: 特朗普在凡尔赛宫签署美伊协议
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has signed an agreement to extend the ceasefire with Iran in France's Palace of Versailles, just outside Paris.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在巴黎外的凡尔赛宫与伊朗签署延长停火协议.

items.title: US-Iran deal leaves core sticking points unresolved - and a $300bn question
items.title_zh: 美伊协议没有解决核心问题,
items.summary: The US-Iran memorandum of understanding announced on Wednesday amounts to a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and a deal to try to reach a final agreement on almost everything else.
items.summary_zh: 美国-伊朗星期三宣布的谅解备忘录相当于重新开放霍尔木兹海峡,并达成一项协议,试图就几乎所有其它问题达成最后协议。

items.title: 'Warning fire went up': Couple on board yacht describe encounter with Russian warship
items.title_zh: "警告火势上升": 乘坐游艇的夫妇描述与俄国军舰相遇
items.summary: Retired British couple Jane and Alan Kelvey spoke to BBC's Newsnight after coming into close contact with Russian frigate the Admiral Grigorovich on Tuesday morning.
items.summary_zh: 退休的英国夫妇简和艾伦·凯尔维在星期二早上与"格里戈罗维奇"上将号俄国护卫舰密切接触后,与BBC的"新闻之夜"进行了交谈.
